prose: OpenAI says Plus and Pro subscribers can use their existing plan allowances inside third-party AI and coding platforms - Amp, Devin, Lovable, and OpenClaw - plus developer and productivity platforms including Notion and Vercel. The move turns the ChatGPT subscription into portable compute credit across the ecosystem rather than a single-app entitlement. The cached source is partially cluttered with newsletter chrome, so finer mechanics (billing, caps per platform) are not captured here.
highlights: Plus/Pro allowances now work inside Amp, Devin, Lovable, and OpenClaw
Also Notion and Vercel among broader platforms
Turns the ChatGPT subscription into portable usage credit across third-party tools
The cached source was partially newsletter chrome; fine mechanics are unverified
